# Siddhant Vishnu

> Founder, product engineer, and systems thinker (age 21). I enter unfamiliar systems, find the leverage, and build what should have existed. Currently co-founding Mirage (adaptive browser interfaces for the AI-native web) while serving as Lead Engineer and Product Manager at a healthcare-AI startup, and studying Computer Engineering.

## About

- Pattern: enters unfamiliar domains, learns from first principles, and ships useful systems before the opportunity is obvious to most people.
- Operating principles: learn by entering; talk to the users; creative thinking over code; distribution is the product.
- AI-native builder: designs around agents and orchestration rather than headcount.
- Recognition: accepted into the 16VC Summer Founder Fellowship; selected for YC Startup School India (top ~2000 nationally, April 2026); 1st place at the IIT Bombay TechFest AI Quest hackathon; a short-form post that reached 600K views.

## Work

- Froncort.AI (healthcare AI, current): intern to Lead Engineer to Product Manager in ~12 months; leads 3 product teams and 9 engineers across live, enterprise healthcare-AI products.
  - RegDoc: FDA / EU-MDR-aligned domain agents that cut regulatory documentation from weeks to minutes.
  - AI NETRA: agentic + geospatial inference for TB outbreak prediction and supply allocation; built with FIND, backed by Google.org; demoed at the India AI Impact Summit 2026; cut TB screening effort by ~55%.
- Mirage (co-founder): browser interfaces that reshape any website around the person using it, with agents at the core. Working demos, 400-person waitlist, MVP in progress.
- Other builds: MercuryAI (enterprise knowledge RAG), Urban Eye AI (real-time city event detection on edge devices), Oasis (campus social network, 1,200+ organic users), Steal or Share (multiplayer game-theory game), sid.breaks.prod (distribution experiment, 0 to 1,000 followers in 6 weeks).
